lines:
  - id: f2441.h_provider_count

    type: Bool

  - id: f2441.h_qp_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying persons listed on line 2"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: dependent
      field: dependent.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
    note: "Open: a qualifying person who is not a dependent on this return (the f2441.nondependent case, or a disabled spouse) has no entry in the dependent collection, and the closed interface supplies no count of such persons. Only dependent entries that are qualifying persons (dependent.dc_qp) are counted. The $3,000/$6,000 limit and the line 2 box use this count."

  - id: f2441.line2_box
    printed: "2 (box)"
    label: "Information about your qualifying person(s). If you have more than three qualifying persons, see the instructions and check this box"
    type: Bool

    printed: "(helper)"

    type: NonNegDollars

    printed: "(helper)"

    type: NonNegDollars

        - guard: {op: test, eq: [f2441.h_two_or_more, {const: false}]}
          then: f2441.h_limit_one

  - id: f2441.h_line3_direct
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Add the amounts in column (d) of line 2. Don't enter more than $3,000 if you had one qualifying person or $6,000 if you had two or more persons"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [f2441.h_col_d_total, f2441.h_dollar_limit]}

    printed: "3"

    label: "Taxable benefits. Subtract line 25 from line 23. If zero or less, enter -0-. Also, enter this amount on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 1e"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f2441.line23, take: f2441.line25}
    shown_when: f2441.benefits

  - id: f2441.line27
    printed: "27"
    label: "Enter $3,000 ($6,000 if two or more qualifying persons)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: copy, from: f2441.h_dollar_limit}
    shown_when: f2441.benefits

  - id: f2441.line28
    printed: "28"
    label: "Add lines 24 and 25"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [f2441.line24, f2441.line25]}
    shown_when: f2441.benefits

  - id: f2441.line29
    printed: "29"
    label: "Subtract line 28 from line 27. If zero or less, stop. You can't take the credit. Exception. If you paid 2024 expenses in 2025, see the instructions for line 9b"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f2441.line27, take: f2441.line28}
    shown_when: f2441.benefits
    note: "The STOP case gives zero here, which makes line 31 and line 3 zero, so line 9a gives no credit. The line 9b exception for 2024 expenses is handled on line 9b and is outside this slice."

  - id: f2441.line30
    printed: "30"
    label: "Complete line 2 on page 1 of this form. Don't include in column (d) any benefits shown on line 28 above. Then, add the amounts in column (d) and enter the total here"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: f2441.h_col_d_total, take: f2441.line28}
    shown_when: f2441.benefits
    note: "Open: the per-person column (d) amounts (dependent.dc_line2d) are read as including expenses paid with dependent care benefits, as the dependent.dc_paid input says ('Form 2441 subtracts the benefits you exclude'). The line 28 benefits are therefore removed from the column (d) total here, with a floor of zero, rather than allocated person by person."

  - id: f2441.line31
    printed: "31"
    label: "Enter the smaller of line 29 or 30. Also, enter this amount on line 3 on page 1 of this form and complete lines 4 through 11"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [f2441.line29, f2441.line30]}
    shown_when: f2441.benefits
